title: Database connection pool exhaustion
actions: Inspect slow queries and leaked connections before changing pool limits.
Compare active connections with database capacity; involve the database owner.
After an approved mitigation, verify pool utilization and checkout error rate recover.

title: Payment provider outage
actions: Check the payment provider status and dependency health.
Ask the incident owner to consider the approved circuit-breaker procedure.
Verify provider errors and checkout errors recover before closing the incident.

title: Checkout deployment regression
actions: Compare the deployed payload contract with the previous version.
Ask the release owner to review a rollback to the last known good version.
After an approved change, verify validation failures and checkout errors recover.

title: Worker memory pressure
actions: Inspect heap growth, container limits, and restart history.
Ask the service owner to consider the approved capacity or restart procedure.
Verify memory stabilizes and worker restarts stop before closing the incident.
